description: UNVERIFIED - HAND A/B ONLY. DO NOT SHIP THIS ALONGSIDE ANYTHING ELSE. WHAT IT DOES: raises the jostle heading-blend coefficient at 0x144046397 from 0.4 to 0.6. This was edit 3 of the first draft of phys-jostle-push; it was pulled because emulating the function contradicted the story told about it. WHAT IS ACTUALLY DEMONSTRATED (level a, re-run this pass under Unicorn on the pristine image with the attribute getter under my control, stock vs this pack's bytes as an emulation-only overlay). Jostle kind 4 is the only one of the 19 jump-table entries that routes to the strength ramp. The function writes a weight w. With dPC = PC_self - PC_other, caller branch r9b=1 (the caller uses w): dPC=-40 0.600 -> 0.400; -10 0.750 -> 0.625; 0 0.800 -> 0.700; +10 0.850 -> 0.775; +40 1.000 -> 1.000. Caller branch r9b=0 (the caller uses 1-w): dPC=0 0.200 -> 0.300; +40 0.400 -> 0.600. WHY THAT IS NOT WHAT THE ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION CLAIMED. The strength sensitivity does rise - the slope goes 0.005 to 0.0075 per point, a genuine +50%. But the equal-strength baseline moves by a constant 0.10 on every jostle, in OPPOSITE directions on the two caller branches, and 0.10 is what a whole 20-point strength gap buys at stock. At the +/-10 point gaps real squads actually have, that constant offset outweighs the strength gain about 4 to 1. So the dominant effect of this edit is a blanket shift in how two jostling players blend headings, not 'strength matters more'. Note also that c = 1.0 is the value at which the two caller branches become identical, so the stock 0.4 encodes a deliberate role asymmetry between the two men and 0.6 half-erases it. WHAT IS STILL UNPROVEN (level c) AND WHY THIS IS IN AN UNVERIFIED FILE: which of the two headings the weight is applied to. The caller lerps out = (1-x)*A + x*B at 0x144048163-0x1440481a0 and has a branch that swaps which side gets x, so the sign of the gameplay effect is genuinely undetermined. If it is backwards, this makes the WEAKER man steer more - which would be visible within a few minutes. RISK: low. It is a blend weight in [0,1], no clamp is crossed, nothing can crash, and it reverts cleanly. But it is the kind of change that alters the feel of every shoulder contact in the match, so A/B it alone, against a saved stock session, and decide by eye. REVERT: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/phys-jostle-blend-UNVERIFIED-AB.json

patches.name: jostle heading blend coefficient 0.4 -> 0.6
patches.note: mulss xmm1, [0x145b2a690 = 0.4] re-aimed to [0x147850258 = 0.6]; xmm1 is a 0..1 term (clamped at 0x144046373/0x144046386, divisor -80.0) that is 0 at a +40 strength advantage and 1 at -40, and the product is subtracted from 1.0 at 0x1440463a7 and stored to the 7th argument.
